name: hedera-agent-passport
description: Agent passport template for Hedera: ERC-721 passport NFT + on-chain event log, Hono API, agent-ready docs.

envVars.description: Hedera testnet account (create at https://portal.hedera.com — free testnet HBAR)
ECDSA private key (hex, 0x-prefixed) — works for both SDK and HSCS/EVM calls

steps.label: Configure Hedera testnet credentials
steps.text: Copy .env.example to .env and fill HEDERA_OPERATOR_ID + HEDERA_PRIVATE_KEY (free testnet account at https://portal.hedera.com)

steps.label: Deploy contracts
steps.text: Deploys AgentPassportNFT + AgentEventLog to Hedera testnet and prints contract addresses

steps.label: Read the agent guide
steps.text: See AGENTS.md — repo layout, commands and conventions for AI agents
